message.content:
A medium-sized tomato (about 123 g) contains roughly **22 calories**.  
The calorie content can vary slightly depending on size and variety:

| Size (approx.) | Weight (g) | Calories |
|----------------|------------|----------|
| Small (≈90 g)  | 90         | ~18      |
| Medium (≈123 g)| 123        | ~22      |
| Large (≈182 g) | 182        | ~33      |

So if you’re eating a typical medium tomato, you’re looking at about 20–25 calories.
